<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check state graph to understand tried actions from current node
print(f"Current state_node_id: {last_action_result.get('state_node_id')}")

# Use state_graph to check tried actions
try:
    current_node = last_action_result.get('state_node_id', 0)
    print(f"Current node: {current_node}")
    print(f"Neighbors of node {current_node}: {state_graph.neighbors(current_node)}")
    print(f"Tried actions from node {current_node}: {state_graph.tried_actions(current_node)}")
    print(f"Frontier: {state_graph.frontier()}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

# Try RIGHT from start (untried action)
result = action(['RIGHT'])
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: executed={result.get('executed')}, game_over={result.get('game_over')}")
if result.get('executed'):
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    blue_node = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b']
    if blue_node:
        boundary = blue_node[0]['boundary']
        center_r = sum(p[0] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        center_c = sum(p[1] for p in boundary) // len(boundary)
        print(f"Blue center: ({center_r}, {center_c})")
        block_r = (center_r - 21) // 3
        block_c = (center_c - 12) // 3
        print(f"Blue block: ({block_r}, {block_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
